description: This file contains unit tests for the NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzer, which detects improper use of ref, out, and in parameters in Orleans grain interface methods. The tests verify that the analyzer correctly identifies violations and allows acceptable scenarios.

classes.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzer, testing detection of ref, out, and in parameters in Orleans grain interface methods.

methods.name: NoRefParamsAllowedInGrainInterfaceMethods
methods.description: Test that ref parameters in grain interface methods are detected as diagnostics.

methods.name: NoOutParamsAllowedInGrainInterfaceMethods
methods.description: Test that out parameters in grain interface methods are detected as diagnostics.

methods.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzerInClass
methods.description: Test multiple ref and out parameters in interface and implementation classes, verifying multiple diagnostics.

methods.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzerNoError
methods.description: Test that normal parameters do not produce diagnostics.

methods.name: OutAndRefParamsAllowedInStaticGrainInterfaceMethods
methods.description: Test that static methods with ref/out parameters do not produce diagnostics, as they are not subject to distributed call restrictions.
